title: Social
slide_intent: Show why a post and a story need different reading structures. One includes a caption outside the image while the other must carry its message inside a vertical frame.
strategic_value: Instacart can keep food imagery central across social formats and vary the type treatment to fit the pace of each format.
demonstration: The post pairs a mocktail preparation image with a short seasonal headline and a caption. The taller story pairs a close image of pasta with oversized cropped lettering.
practical_value: For a feed post, divide information between image and caption. For a story, put the expressive line directly in the image frame.

content_islands.name: Feed post
content_islands.spec: Center the social post on the left. Include the account header, image headline and caption beneath.

content_islands.name: Story
content_islands.spec: Set the taller story on the right and crop the repeated lettering at the image edges. Keep the contrasting food moment visible between the words.
